title: Chapter 557
paragraphs: Chapter 557
Episode. The King of the Black Sea, Glyiek (1)
"Stand back!"
Talarris hastily braced herself.
In place of the fortress, a huge wall of ice spread out in all directions, which was close to Talarris's full strength, excluding the power tied to the seal of Elona Zipul.
However, the energy of chaos tore through even that with no difficulty. The onslaught of chaos that engulfed her and Jin's party could be slightly delayed, but that was all.
"Kahak!"
Talarris spat out a clot of blood again and widened her eyes. There was a twitch in her eye, and the hand holding the sword was trembling.
It wasn't trembling with fear, but it was not without fear.
The tidal wave of chaos pouring out from the white stone now was so vast that even she couldn't estimate.
-It may be hard to believe, but that white stone, if refined and used, can support all the magical equipment of the empire and instantly make the empire several times more powerful.
The testimony of the traitor Tion Hyran.
-It has already been proven by the arrival of a large reinforcement now. The white stone is a must-have item for them. But we still don't know what it is.
Rosa's assessment.
-Our predecessors left a record that Hyran had one object that could be a threat to the world. Our Begonia suspects that the object that Hyran has is the object of the witch Helurum.
-...It's a seal that can withstand even the absolute power of the ice without flinching. Do you know what this means? It means that a chaos I can't even handle is lurking inside.
Talarris's speculation.
All of these stories were either wrong or lacking. What had been dormant in the white stone was a being that far exceeded their expectations.
The King of the Black Sea, Glyiek.
The fifth ruler of Chaos.
Only Kinzel knew his identity. Even Kelliak had not expected that what was sealed in the white stone would be Glyiek.
The ice emitted a dazzling radiance. What would usually illuminate the surroundings was merely weak like a candle in front of Glyiek's chaos.
The Ice Sword was drawn. If she hesitated even for a moment, not only she, but also Jin's party would never be safe.
Third form: Avalanche, fourth form: Frost Drive, tenth form: Glacier Splitter. Talarris's essence, the ghostly white sword, extended towards the approaching chaos.
The chaos was repelling the Ice as if it was a joke.
'The white stone was the King of the Black Sea...!'
Chiiii-!
The Ice became even more integrated with Talarris, emitting a rough resonating sound like a roar.
The rushing chaos finally showed signs of slowing down at that moment.
Ice Sword's fifth form...
As Talaris plunged his glacial blade into the ground, ice blossoms bloomed all around, massive as mountains.
Incredibly sharp and solid, the ice flower shattered and eroded space, moving at a speed close to light.

Black blood poured ceaselessly from Talaris' quivering lips and nose. He had been single-handedly holding back the rampage of the White Stone alongside Elona's seal, a task that would be taxing for even Talaris.
Gasping, Talaris amplified the energy of the White Aether.
He was struggling against the chaos. He desperately blocked the chaos that sought to enter the white, crushing the ice flowers.
"Damn it... Why is that thing here and not in the Black Sea?"

Talaris, who said this, was pale. His hair was already disheveled, he was sweating profusely, and the black gold that formed the White Aether was shaking unstably as if it would be uprooted from the ground at any moment.
Talaris Endorma, the master of the Labyrinth and the unrivaled warrior acknowledged even by the Shi'ron, encountered difficulties as soon as the chaos woke up.
"Master Talaris!"
"Jin, listen carefully. That's the King of the Black Sea. Even if everyone on the battlefield joins forces... Damn it, are the outsiders still not ready!"
The space where Talaris was blocking the chaos was only a tiny part.
The chaos had already spread across the entire battlefield beyond the ice flowers, only the White Aether hadn't been shattered yet.
Talaris was merely buying time.
Time for Ron, Kelliac, Runkandel, and Ziphel outside to push back the chaos even a little. If the Aether inside broke, it would be the end.
"And that bastard, he... he wants you...!"
The King of the Black Sea's resentment towards the shadow.
Facing the chaos, Talaris vividly felt this hatred. It wasn't directed at himself, who was struggling so hard to block the chaos, but at Jin.
Jin felt the same way.
As soon as the chaos woke up, he instinctively felt that he was being targeted. A hatred so deep that it almost seemed to have a physical form was pressing down on Jin's entire body.
A pressure that felt like turning his body to stone, as if his father was showing his jealousy through his full attention.
If it weren't for Talaris, Jin wouldn't have been safe this time.

He alone couldn't possibly handle it, his companions were exhausted, and the guardian dragons that were supposed to protect him were either not as they used to be or completely depleted of their strength.
Moreover, the enemy was stronger and larger than anything Jin and his companions had faced so far, and Talaris couldn't hold out for very long.
After the end of the White Aether, she needed time to recover her strength and retrieve some of the power used in Elona Ziphel's seal in order to fight properly again.
If the Emperor hadn't made a deal with Ziphel, if Ziphel hadn't shown such excessive greed, if the world hadn't driven Hailan and the Sword Emperor into a corner...
That dreadful being would never have awoken in this world.
Drip, drip.
The blood that flowed from Talalris's face left red spots on the frozen white ground.
And within the white area formed by Talalris, another problem was arising.
[Screech-! Screaaaam!]
Suddenly, Amela's eyes rolled back and she began to convulse.
It was because the chaos within her was reacting to Gliyak's energy and running wild.
If Yona hadn't once crushed that chaos, Amela wouldn't have lasted a few seconds before going mad and attacking her comrades.
[Please, help, somehow, aaah!]
Even Rata and Faye, along with her, were groaning and collapsing. The faint scent of chaos they had inherited from Smarion was also reacting to Gliyak's power.
"My lord, if I ever attack our comrades, please do not hesitate to cut me down and restrain me. Even now... my sanity...!"
Thud!
Rata managed to keep her sanity by desperately stabbing her own thigh and Faye's shoulder, but she could no longer continue the battle.
"Ghost Captain!"
"Rata, Faye!"
The white area was breaking.
Jin had to decide what he could do.
'At this rate, both Talalris and my comrades are in danger. I have to think of a way...!'
He couldn't use the Spirit Sword Special Technique, Black Summoning yet.
'Instead, there are Stal Knights and Black Knights behind me.'
Just outside the broken inner wall, Stal and the Black Knights were now responding to chaos rather than the ghost troops. There was no room for them to point swords and staves at each other.
'Stal Knight received an order from the family to save me. Moreover, in terms of position, Stal Knight is also receiving Talalris's help.'
As he expected, Stal was desperately trying to enter the white area. In his judgment, at present, no one among his comrades could protect Jin once the white area was breached.
"Talalris, is it possible to gather some of the energy spread in the rear?"

Talalris immediately understood what he meant. Before Gliyak awoke, she had also sensed the presence of Stal and the Black Knights. She just hadn't thought about it while frantically fending off chaos.
"Stal and the Black Knights, but Jin. It's a gamble to some extent. As soon as the ice sculptures in the rear disappear, chaos will enter with them."
Before answering, Jin.
He formed a summoning circle with desperate prayers.
To call his phoenix, which was focusing on recovery after he had infused a part of his power into Bradamante last year.
It was not an act of blindly hoping for luck.
'The blue flame in Bradamante is reacting strongly as soon as the chaos awakens. As if Tes forcibly used my power to manifest in the old Oterium.'
Jin's desperate wish was answered before a few seconds had passed.
Tes had been preparing to manifest since immediately after Gliyak was released from the white stone.
Although he hadn't fully recovered his strength, now was not the time to worry about that.
Screeaaam-!
Tes emerged from the summoning circle, revealing the majesty of the owner of the Flame Realm.

Moreover, unlike in the old Oterium, he did not bring forth his original power as collateral for Jin's power. Instead, he used the authority of the Flame Realm's owner to partially purify the chaos scattered around and used it as a medium.
He couldn't use chaos as a medium indefinitely. Even for Tes, exposure to chaos in this way is clearly dangerous, but he judged it to be better than risking the life of the contractor.
"Tes!"
"Lord Tes!?"
"Oh, I'm so glad to see this guy!"
Jin, Misha, and Murakan shouted simultaneously, and with the appearance of Tes, the chaos that had been crushing the ice sculpture once again showed signs of retreating.
At the same time, Talalris broke some of the ice sculptures behind her, and Stal and the Black Knights entered.
Octavia and the ghost troops were not visible. They were retreating towards the main force to avoid the chaos.
"12th Knight!"
"We're safe!"
Crash-!
Then the ice sculptures in the front burst and bent, and the hesitating chaos poured inward.

Stal and the Black Knights stepped forward without hesitation and swung their swords in place of Talalris, but it wasn't to save her and the other comrades. It was just an impossible situation to only save Jin.
Anyway, thanks to them, Talalris was able to catch her breath for a moment, and Jin and his comrades could hear the voices of the two people giving orders from outside with all their might.
"Runkandel's former knights, protect the 12th Knight, at all costs!"
"Secure Jin Runkandel, he must not be devoured by chaos!"
Rosa Runkandel and Kelliac Ziphel.
Following the orders of each leader, all the personnel of Runkandel and Ziphel were throwing themselves in to save Jin.
